evals.name: prunes stale content rather than only appending
evals.prompt: It's been a few weeks since the architecture doc was touched and we've rebuilt a good chunk of the system since. Sync the docs.
evals.expected_output: Corrects and removes content that no longer matches the code, instead of appending new text alongside stale text.
assertions: The response corrects or removes stale content rather than only adding new text.
The response reports what changed per document.
